bias_targets.methodology: Measuring representation fairness using Equal Coverage and Coverage Parity metrics, which rely on textual entailment models to quantify how equally a summary covers input news articles and tweets with left, center, and right political ideologies.

Evaluating multi-document summaries of product reviews using Equal Coverage and Coverage Parity metrics via textual entailment to determine if positive, negative, and neutral sentiments from the source documents are proportionately represented.
Calculating Equal Coverage and Coverage Parity metrics based on textual entailment to assess whether summaries fairly represent input documents that support or oppose a specific target or claim.
